title: Permission
description: A permission for a file or shared drive.

type.description: The type of grantee (user, group, domain, anyone).

role.description: The role granted by this permission (owner, organizer, fileOrganizer, writer, commenter, reader).

emailAddress.description: The email address of the grantee, if applicable.

domain.description: The domain to which the permission applies, if applicable.
